forms.name: Dual Toxocyst (Incarnon)
forms.activation: Weakpoint hits charge the Incarnon gauge; 9 weakpoint hits fill it. Alt Fire transmutes into the Incarnon form.

options.name: Incarnon Form
options.effect: Gain auto-fire mode; each shot ricochets to 1 nearby enemy within 5m.

options.name: Carnage Reign
options.effect: +60 base damage; +33% damage per status type currently on the target.

options.name: Fevered Frenzy
options.effect: +50 base damage; +5% multishot per ability cast, stacking up to 20x.

options.name: Ready Retaliation
options.effect: +100% reload speed when reloading from empty.

options.name: Evolved Autoloader
options.effect: +50% magazine reload per second while holstered.
